channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Heating oil costs rise, impacting households
item.description: Households in the US and the UK are facing significantly higher costs for heating oil this winter. In the US, millions of homeowners are projected to pay hundreds of dollars more due to a surge in prices, with a 21% increase in costs for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar Hits Six-Year Low
item.description: The New Zealand dollar has fallen to its lowest point in six years against the US dollar. This marks a significant depreciation for the currency. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Calgary budget proposes fee hikes for recreation, minor sports
item.description: Calgary's proposed budget includes increases to ice rental fees, which could make participation in minor hockey and ringette more expensive. The proposed changes to recreation funding and ice rental fees have drawn criticism. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Satellite firm Iceye bids for rocket maker Avio
item.description: Finnish satellite company Iceye has launched a bid to acquire Italian rocket maker Avio. The bid is valued at $2.3 billion, or €2 billion. The acquisition would combine a satellite technology firm with a rocket manufacturer. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Germany Cuts Energy Tax and Extends Fuel Price Cap
item.description: Germany will reduce its electricity tax and extend a cap on fuel prices until 2027. These measures are expected to save families approximately €8 per month and maintain affordable petrol prices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: New tax rules are being introduced that may impact individuals' eligibility for the age pension. The specific details of these rules and their direct consequences on pension recipients are not elaborated upon in the provided coverage, but… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is reportedly preparing for a significant initial public offering (IPO) this week, which is being viewed as a key test for the broader AI stock market. Wall Street is anticipating strong investor… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Major Tech Outages Hit Apple, Microsoft, and US Banks
item.description: A series of significant technological disruptions affected major companies and services in a single week. Apple experienced widespread outages impacting iCloud, the App Store, and Apple Pay. Concurrently, Microsoft and several US banks… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Lord's Mark Industries announced its financial results for the first half of fiscal year 2027 (H1 FY27), reporting a profit of ₹82 Crore. This figure is 1.7 times the company's entire profit for fiscal year 2026 (FY26). The company also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Coal India is planning an Initial Public Offering (IPO) for its subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), described as a "cash cow" that generates a third of Coal India's profit and is debt-free. Despite its financial strength and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh to establish first semiconductor plant with ₹2,387 crore investment
item.description: Andhra Pradesh is set to establish its first semiconductor plant near Visakhapatnam, with an investment of ₹2,387 crore. The facility, located at Tarluvada, will focus on chip assembly and testing. This project is part of the state's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Report Claims Nvidia CEO's Wife Aided $9 Billion China AI Network
item.description: A report alleges that Alice Huang, wife of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, played a role in building a $9 billion AI network with assistance from China. The network is described as a data center empire. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Centre offers up to 75% relief on groundwater environmental compensation
item.description: The Central government has introduced a one-time settlement scheme offering 30% to 75% relief on environmental compensation for groundwater users. This initiative aims to regulate, regularize, and settle disputes related to groundwater… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: SpiceJet Flights Halted in Mumbai, Passengers Stranded
item.description: SpiceJet flights were unable to depart from Mumbai for 12 hours, leaving hundreds of passengers stranded at the airport. Chaos reportedly erupted due to the disruption. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Surat-Bilimora Bullet Train Section to be Electrified
item.description: The 50-kilometer Surat-Bilimora section of the bullet train project in Gujarat is scheduled to be electrified on November 20. The National High-Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL) will energize this section with 25,000 volts. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Onion Farmers Seek Rs 3,000/Quintal Amid Surplus Fears
item.description: Onion farmers are demanding government measures to ensure a price of Rs 3,000 per quintal, citing fears of a surplus in production. The demand comes as farmers anticipate a large yield, which could potentially drive down market prices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Commerce Ministry has amended certain rules under its Export Promotion Mission initiative to provide support to exporters. Revised guidelines now permit Micro and Small Exporters to claim up to 95% of their airfare costs for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India plans to order 1,000 new civilian aircraft
item.description: India is preparing to order 1,000 new civilian aircraft to address an "acute fleet crunch," according to reports. The move aims to alleviate future flight shortages. The plan was mentioned by Piyush Goyal. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Personal Loan Interest Rates Explained for Debt Consolidation
item.description: Information is provided on personal loans for credit card debt consolidation, including comparisons of interest rates and explanations of reducing balance, EMI, and total interest. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella stated that the company's voluntary exit offer is intended to provide employees with greater career flexibility. He explained that this initiative is a response to AI and evolving business needs, which are… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Acme Solar has entered into a 150 MW hybrid power purchase agreement with NTPC. The project, which will combine solar, wind, and energy storage, is set to be implemented across Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh. The agreement… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Air India Express Appoints Deepak Rajawat as New CEO
item.description: Air India Express has appointed its Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Deepak Rajawat, as the new Chief Executive Officer (CEO). The appointment is scheduled to take effect from December 1. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Tata Steel CEO T V Narendran has raised concerns about the threat posed by Chinese steel imports to India's domestic industry. He stated that the company is exploring additional electric arc furnace projects and aims to expand its… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.description: Amazon has announced a commitment to invest $7 billion in India's renewable energy sector by 2030. This investment will support the procurement of renewable energy and includes the unveiling of four new projects. The company has signed new… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: As Black Friday sales approach, consumers are being advised to be vigilant against scams and consider purchasing refurbished electronics as a cheaper and more environmentally friendly option. Experts offer guidance on how to identify… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Nvidia's board of directors is facing an oversight test due to the absence of a chief compliance officer. The company's new leadership is tasked with addressing this vacancy, which raises questions about internal governance and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: India's stock market experienced a downturn, with indicators suggesting a potential pause in its ongoing rally. This decline is attributed to a combination of global geopolitical tensions, including conflicts in the US, Iran, Russia, and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: The Indian Rupee saw a significant appreciation against the US Dollar, reaching 93.27 in early trade, with reports indicating a rise of 24 paise. Another report stated the Rupee closed at 93.92, having risen 27 paise. Factors contributing… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.description: Apple services including iCloud, the App Store, and Apple Pay experienced a widespread outage that affected users across the US. The services were restored after an internal update. Separately, Chase Bank reported that its operations were… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: Vietnamese electric vehicle manufacturer VinFast is set to launch three electric scooter models in India in the coming year. The company, which has already established a presence in the electric car market, confirmed its entry into the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) in 2026 are resulting in investor losses, a trend also observed in the current year's biggest IPOs. This situation coincides with investors reducing their exposure to tech stocks, marking the most… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.description: Fairfax India Holdings Corp, through its affiliate FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd, is divesting its entire 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance. The sale involves over 5.6 crore shares and is being conducted via a block deal appraised at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Collins Aerospace to open new MRO facility near Bengaluru
item.description: Collins Aerospace plans to expand its presence in India by establishing a new Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) facility near Bengaluru. The facility is expected to commence operations by 2029. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Decline to Year-Low Amid Interest Rate Hike Fears
item.description: Gold and silver prices have fallen to their lowest levels in a year, with a notable decline observed across major cities on November 18. This price drop is attributed to fears of expected interest rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Treasury Yields Decline Amidst Investor Wait for Nvidia Data
item.description: Treasury yields saw a decline as investors awaited data from Nvidia. Yields also moderated as market participants parsed through retail sales data. The market is observing these indicators while anticipating further economic signals. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi's Khan Market Ranks Among World's Top 25 Most Expensive Retail Streets
item.description: Delhi's Khan Market has been ranked as the 24th most expensive retail street globally, according to a report by Cushman & Wakefield. The report also indicated a 14% rise in rents for the market. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: EU Urges France, Belgium to Reduce National Debts
item.description: The European Union has urged France and Belgium to reduce their national debts and deficits. The specific details of the EU's recommendations or the exact figures for the debts and deficits were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
